text: F5.2 left the costliest Gromark rules untried under the old half-hour budget: three-term rules in base 26 (a letter primer read as digits, YAR among them) and two-term rules with lags 7-10.

Every rule and every one of 234,092,726,300 starting runs, four ways of applying the digit, any mixed alphabet: repeated known letters pin digit differences, then all 24 letters must match one to one.
K4 0 settings, ten scrambled copies 0-3; the three planted texts are found (4, 1, 2). F5.2 closed.
